items.title: Smart Locker System
items.desc: An IoT-powered smart locker combining hardware sensors with a software dashboard. Enables secure access control, real-time monitoring and remote management through a React-based interface integrated with Firebase.

items.title: UI/UX Design Projects
items.desc: A collection of responsive and user-friendly interface designs crafted in Figma. Focused on modern design patterns, accessibility, and pixel-perfect implementations.

items.title: Mobile App Concept
items.desc: A mobile-first application concept focusing on intuitive navigation and smooth animations. Designed with user experience at the forefront, combining React Native principles with Firebase backend.

items.title: Python Automation Tools
items.desc: A suite of Python scripts and Tkinter GUI applications for automating repetitive tasks. Includes file management utilities, data processing scripts, and GUI-based tools.
